items.text: Fireworks AI launched Nexus, a drop-in router that sends routine coding requests to open-weight models, reporting 3–5x cost cuts and 33% lower cost per merged PR.
items.text_zh: Fireworks AI 推出 Nexus 路由层，把常规编码请求分流到开源权重模型，官方称成本降低 3–5 倍、每个合并 PR 的成本下降 33%。

items.text: ElevenLabs extended ElevenAgents to SMS, Telegram, email and ticketing, with per-channel response controls so one agent keeps the same knowledge, tools and guardrails everywhere.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 将 ElevenAgents 扩展到短信、Telegram、邮件与工单渠道，并新增分渠道回复风格控制，同一个智能体在各端共用知识、工具与安全护栏。

items.text: Perplexity brought Model Council into its Computer agent, running one question across multiple frontier models in parallel and merging them into a single cited report.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 把 Model Council 引入 Computer 智能体，可让同一问题在多个前沿模型上并行分析，最终合成一份带引用的统一报告。

items.text: OpenAI published a report on agentic scientific computing, using eight industry and academic case studies to argue coding agents shift researchers toward verification and stewardship.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布智能体科学计算报告，通过产业界与学术界的八个案例说明：编码智能体正把科研人员的工作重心推向验证与治理。

items.text: Ideogram said it is partnering with AMD to serve its open-weight Ideogram 4.0 image model at scale on Instinct accelerators.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 宣布与 AMD 合作，用 Instinct 加速器为其开源权重图像模型 Ideogram 4.0 提供大规模推理服务。

items.text: Runway announced that ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model is coming soon to its platform, adding a rival lab's generator to Runway's tool lineup.
items.text_zh: Runway 宣布字节跳动的 Seedance 2.5 视频模型即将上线其平台，把竞争实验室的生成模型纳入自家工具箱。

items.text: Fish Audio raised a $52M seed led by Coreline Ventures and Capital Today for voice models with 15,000+ controls, citing 8M users and $21M ARR.
items.text_zh: 语音模型公司 Fish Audio 完成 5200 万美元种子轮，由 Coreline Ventures 与今日资本领投；其模型支持超 1.5 万项控制，已有 800 万用户、2100 万美元 ARR。

items.text: Nvidia is investing in Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence, moving the ~$30B-valued lab off Google TPUs onto Vera Rubin GPUs for a claimed tenfold compute boost.
items.text_zh: 英伟达投资伊利亚·苏茨克维的 Safe Superintelligence，这家估值约 300 亿美元的实验室将从谷歌 TPU 转向 Vera Rubin GPU，算力据称提升十倍。

items.text: LMArena said xAI's Grok 4.6 arrives August 7 and will enter the arena leaderboards next week.
items.text_zh: LMArena 透露 xAI 的 Grok 4.6 将于 8 月 7 日发布，下周即会进入竞技场榜单参评。

items.text: Liquid AI open-weighted LFM2.5-Encoders, 230M and 350M encoders with 8,192-token context that run about 3.7x faster than ModernBERT-base on CPU.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 开放 LFM2.5-Encoders 权重，包含 230M 与 350M 两款编码器，支持 8192 token 上下文，CPU 上速度约为 ModernBERT-base 的 3.7 倍。

items.text: Ai2 detailed its OlmoEarth Platform, which ran a North America wildfire-risk job on 19,600 CPUs and 994 GPUs for a 155x speedup over serial inference.
items.text_zh: Ai2 公布 OlmoEarth 平台细节：一次北美野火风险推理任务动用 19600 个 CPU 与 994 张 GPU，相比串行推理提速 155 倍。

items.text: PJM, the largest US grid, will curtail power to data centers of 50MW or more during shortages from June 2027, with advance notice and compensation.
items.text_zh: 美国最大电网运营商 PJM 将从 2027 年 6 月起，在电力紧张时对 50 兆瓦以上数据中心限电，并提前通知、给予补偿。

items.text: LMArena's Code Arena added fullstack web development rankings, scoring models on multi-step reasoning and tool use across complete app-building tasks.
items.text_zh: LMArena 的 Code Arena 新增全栈 Web 开发榜单，围绕完整应用构建任务评估模型的多步推理与工具调用能力。

items.text: Pika confirmed that ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model is arriving on its platform soon, echoing a similar teaser from Runway.
items.text_zh: Pika 确认字节跳动的 Seedance 2.5 视频模型即将登陆其平台，与 Runway 此前的预告相呼应。

items.text: PixVerse showed a girl-group music video shot as one continuous orbiting take, the camera circling and revealing each member without cuts.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示了一支女团 MV：全片一镜到底，镜头环绕运动逐一揭示每位成员，没有任何剪辑。

items.text: Kling AI said applications remain open for its Elite Creators Program, recruiting creators who regularly publish Kling-made videos on social platforms.
items.text_zh: 可灵 AI 表示精英创作者计划仍在开放申请，招募经常在社交平台发布可灵作品的创作者。

items.text: Cyera agreed to acquire Oasis Security for about $1 billion, mostly cash, to police non-human identities as enterprise AI agents proliferate.
items.text_zh: Cyera 同意以约 10 亿美元（主要为现金）收购 Oasis Security，以在企业 AI 智能体激增之际管控非人类身份。

items.text: Runlayer sued Rippling for trade-secret misappropriation, alleging it copied Runlayer's MCP gateway after nearly a year of NDA-covered engineering collaboration.
items.text_zh: Runlayer 起诉 Rippling 侵占商业秘密，称对方在近一年的保密协议合作后照搬了其 MCP 网关产品。

items.text: Hubble, a free open-source Markdown and HTML notepad built for humans and their agents to share, reached Hacker News' front page.
items.text_zh: Hubble——一款面向用户与其智能体共用的免费开源 Markdown/HTML 笔记应用——登上 Hacker News 首页。

items.text: Hugging Face published Training Agents 3, a lesson on training a local open-weight agent with reinforcement learning.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 发布《Training Agents 3》教程，讲解如何用强化学习训练本地开放权重智能体。

items.text: Perplexity added Moonshot's Kimi K3 for Pro and Max subscribers in both Perplexity and Perplexity Computer, hosted exclusively on US-based servers.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 向 Pro 与 Max 订阅用户在 Perplexity 及 Perplexity Computer 中上线月之暗面 Kimi K3，并称仅托管于美国服务器。

items.text: LMArena said Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 pushed the Vision Arena Pareto frontier outward with a score of 1283.
items.text_zh: LMArena 称 Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.1 以 1283 分推动了视觉竞技场的性价比帕累托前沿。

items.text: Coursera invested $100 million for a one-third stake in LearnVector, Andrew Ng's new agentic-AI tutoring company, with first products targeted for early 2027.
items.text_zh: Coursera 以 1 亿美元投资换取吴恩达新公司 LearnVector 三分之一股权，该智能体式一对一学习产品预计 2027 年初面世。

items.text: Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence signed a $410 million compute deal with AWS, which will co-develop infrastructure purpose-built for self-improving AI.
items.text_zh: Richard Socher 创办的 Recursive Superintelligence 与 AWS 签下 4.1 亿美元算力协议，双方将共建面向自我改进 AI 的专用基础设施。

items.text: Bot-detection startup Spur raised $200 million led by Insight Partners to separate real humans from bots hiding behind VPNs and residential proxies.
items.text_zh: 机器人检测创企 Spur 获 Insight Partners 领投的 2 亿美元融资，用于识别藏身 VPN 与住宅代理背后的机器人流量。

items.text: Taiwanese prosecutors detained an Nvidia employee in a widening probe into illegal exports of Super Micro AI servers containing Nvidia chips to China.
items.text_zh: 台湾检方在扩大调查中拘留一名英伟达员工，涉嫌非法向中国出口搭载英伟达芯片的 Super Micro AI 服务器。

items.text: Dario Amodei said Anthropic never advocated banning open-weight models, but restated their cyber and bio risks and urged mandatory safety testing regardless of license.
items.text_zh: Dario Amodei 称 Anthropic 从未主张禁止开放权重模型，但重申其网络与生物滥用风险，呼吁不论许可方式都强制安全测试。
